chapter: 支神类属、六亲属类、六亲爻动爻变持世
chapter_en: The Classes of the Branch Spirits and of the Six Relations, and the Relations Moving, Changing and Holding the Self

units.chapter_en: The Classes of the Branch Spirits
units.title: 支神类属·五行各主的身体与症状：亥子耳肾腰、泻冷精逆；巳午眼目心、疮；寅卯手足皮毛肝胆；申酉肺气咳喘骸骨肢筋；辰戌丑未脾胃皮肤、肿腹泻肚、时疫呕吐

rule.yi: 海底眼的支神类属，每一组地支（五行）有一首七言诗和一段散句，说它在世间管的事物，其中带着身体和症状：亥子（水）是耳、肾、腰，泻冷精逆；巳午（火）是眼目、心、疮；寅卯（木）是手足、皮毛、肝胆；申酉（金）是肺气咳喘、骸骨肢筋、眉头；辰戌丑未（土）是脾胃、皮肤、肿腹泻肚、时疫呕吐。
rule.en: In the classes of the branch spirits in the Haidi Yan each group of branches (each phase) has a seven-character poem and a prose passage on what it governs in the world, and these carry the body and its symptoms: Hai and Zi (Water): the ears, kidneys and waist, purging, chill and the essence in reverse; Si and Wu (Fire): the eyes, the heart, sores; Yin and Mao (Wood): hands and feet, skin and hair, liver and gall bladder; Shen and You (Metal): lung qi, coughing and wheezing, bones, limbs and sinews, the brow; Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei (Earth): spleen and stomach, the skin, swelling of the belly and diarrhoea, seasonal epidemics and vomiting.

en: purging, chill, the essence in reverse,
always listening and sorting out the talk,
the ears, kidneys and waist are weak,

yi: 膏药药末、疮、汉（原文如此）、眼、目、心。
en: salve and powder, sores, 'han', the eyes, the eye, the heart.
skin and hair, hands and feet, the many gods of the temple,
liver and gall bladder, sour and fishy tastes, mean fright and weeping.
the four limbs, hands and feet,
liver and gall bladder, fishy and sour,
children grieving and weeping.

yi: 僧尼、道士的行事，邪魔所许的愿，
眉头、喘、咳嗽，发作要用金针。
en: monks and nuns, the conduct of Daoists, vows made to evil demons,
the brow, wheezing and coughing, the golden needle is applied.
lung qi, coughing and wheezing,
bones, limbs and sinews.
the brows, tongue, head and brain,
hair and fur, harm to the body,

yi: 师巫、卜算、药物，背着「元子」（原文如此），
呕吐气逆、皮肤、腹肚鸣响。
en: shamans, diviners, medicines, carrying the 'yuan zi',
vomiting and counterflow, the skin, the belly rumbling.
spleen and stomach, the skin,
a swollen belly, diarrhoea,
seasonal epidemics and vomiting.

note.yi: 这一节的顺序是水（亥子）、火（巳午）、木（寅卯）、金（申酉）、土（辰戌丑未）；每一组先有一首七言诗（诗后带眉批），再有一段散句，这里取的是诗和散句里带身体、症状的几句，别的（山川、人物、器物）不收。身体和脏腑的对应大体和别处一致：水是肾、耳、腰，火是心、眼，木是肝胆、手足，金是肺，土是脾胃（见 LY.ILL.CA.02、YY.11、HJC.16），这里多出的是症状：水「泻冷精逆」，火「疮」，金「咳喘」，土「肿腹泻肚、时疫呕吐」。几处意思不清的：「膏末疮汉眼目心」的「汉」、「师巫卜药负元子」的「元子」、「恒听分论」，书里没有解释，译文照字面。「虡」之类字的注、「眼木（目之误）」这类括号里的校注是整理者加的，不引。「相貌长文」「狩药负子」两处意思不清，这里不收。
note.en: The order in this section is Water (Hai, Zi), Fire (Si, Wu), Wood (Yin, Mao), Metal (Shen, You), Earth (Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei); each group has first a seven-character poem (with a marginal comment after the poem) and then a prose passage, and what is taken here is the lines of the poem and the prose that carry the body and symptoms; the rest (mountains and rivers, people, objects) is not taken. The correspondence of body and viscera is broadly the same as elsewhere: Water the kidneys, ears and waist, Fire the heart and eyes, Wood liver and gall bladder, hands and feet, Metal the lungs, Earth spleen and stomach (see LY.ILL.CA.02, YY.11, HJC.16); what is added here is symptoms: Water 'purging, chill, the essence in reverse', Fire 'sores', Metal 'coughing and wheezing', Earth 'a swollen belly, diarrhoea, seasonal epidemics and vomiting'. Some places are unclear in sense: the 'han' of 'salve and powder, sores, han, eyes, the eye, the heart', the 'yuan zi' of 'carrying the yuan zi', and 'always listening and sorting out the talk', and the book does not explain them, so the translation is literal. The notes on characters such as 'ju' and the bracketed proofreading notes such as 'eye wood (a miswriting of eye)' were added by the editor and are not quoted. 'Looks, long writings' and 'hunting medicine, carrying a child' are unclear in sense and are not taken here.

units.chapter_en: The Classes of the Six Relations
units.title: 六亲属类·子孙：缉捕医药闲渔僧；师巫捕抗，苻药医卜(子孙是医药)

rule.yi: 海底眼的六亲属类里，子孙管的物类里有医药：「缉捕医药闲渔僧」，散句里还有「师巫捕抗，苻药医卜」——子孙是医生和药物（还有符药、卜算）。
rule.en: In the classes of the six relations in the Haidi Yan, among what Output governs are doctors and medicines: 'arrest, doctors and medicines, idle fishermen and monks', and in the prose 'shamans, catching and resisting, charms, medicines, doctors and diviners' — Output is the doctor and the medicine (and also charm-medicines and divining).

yi: 缉捕、医药、闲人、渔人、僧人，
en: arrest, doctors and medicines, idlers, fishermen and monks,

yi: 师巫、捕捉、抗拒（原文如此），
en: shamans, catching and resisting,
charms, medicines, doctors and diviners.

note.yi: 子孙管医药，是整个六爻通例（阐奥歌章 LY.ILL.CA.08、天玄赋 LY.ILL.TXF.12、文王金钱课 LY.ILL.WWJQ.01 等），这里是用类象的歌诀说出来的：子孙这一类里有「医药」「医卜」。「缉捕医药闲渔僧」是一连串的名词，没有动词，译文逐项列出；「苻」是「符」的写法。「捕抗」意思不清，按字面译。
note.en: That Output governs doctors and medicines is a general rule of the whole of the six lines (the Chan'ao Gezhang LY.ILL.CA.08, the Tianxuan Fu LY.ILL.TXF.12, the Wenwang Jinqian Ke LY.ILL.WWJQ.01 and others), and here it is said in a verse of images: in this class of Output there are 'doctors and medicines' and 'doctors and diviners'. 'Arrest, doctors and medicines, idlers, fishermen and monks' is a string of nouns with no verb, and the translation lists them one by one; the character for 'charm' is written in a variant form. 'Catching and resisting' is unclear in sense and is translated literally.

units.chapter_en: The Classes of the Six Relations
units.title: 六亲属类·官鬼：神邪病崇盗，失物输赢灾梦忧；灾害伤身、鬼崇凶祸；疾病疮疖、怪梦虚惊

rule.yi: 海底眼的六亲属类里，官鬼管的物类有：神、邪、病、崇、盗，失物、输赢、灾、梦、忧；散句里还有「灾害伤身，鬼崇凶祸」「疾病疮疖，怪梦虚惊」——官鬼是病和鬼神作祟这一类事。
rule.en: In the classes of the six relations in the Haidi Yan, among what Pressure governs are gods, evil, illness, curses and thieves, lost things, winning and losing, calamity, dreams and worry; the prose adds 'calamity harms the body, ghosts and curses, ill-fortune and misfortune' and 'illness, sores and boils, strange dreams and false alarms' — Pressure is illness and the matters of ghosts and spirits afflicting.

yi: 官鬼管的有：神、邪、病、崇、盗，
电闪、主人、厅堂殿宇一类，
沟渠、监狱、尻（臀部），制住身体的愁苦。
en: Pressure stands for gods, evil, illness, curses and thieves,
lost things, winning and losing, calamity, dreams and worry,
lightning, the master, halls and palaces and the like,
ditches, prisons, the buttocks, the sorrow of a restrained body.
calamity harms the body,
ghosts and curses, ill-fortune and misfortune,
illness, sores and boils,
strange dreams and false alarms.

note.yi: 这是用类象的歌诀说出来的官鬼：占病时官鬼是「病」「崇」，和用神表里「占邪崇、雷霆、鬼神用官鬼」（文王金钱课 LY.ILL.WWJQ.02）、易卦发蒙歌「凡疾病皆视此爻，知鬼神情状」（LY.ILL.BSYG.01）是同一个意思。「崇」是「祟」的写法。「尻」本义是臀部，这里是一连串物象里的一项，按字面译。散句后面还有一行「此尾五句，应在官鬼上，未知是否，存考」，是整理者的话，不引。
note.en: This is Pressure said in a verse of images: in divining illness Pressure is 'illness' and 'curses', which is the same sense as the table of the Subject 'divining evil curses, thunder, ghosts and spirits, use Pressure' (the Wenwang Jinqian Ke LY.ILL.WWJQ.02) and the 'Yigua Fameng Ge' 'in all illness look to this line, and know the state of ghosts and spirits' (LY.ILL.BSYG.01). The character for 'curse' is written in a variant form. 'The buttocks' is the original sense of the word, here one item in a string of images, and is translated literally. After the prose there is a line 'these last five lines should be under Pressure, it is not known; kept for study', which is the editor's words and is not quoted.

units.title: 六亲爻动·疾病：父动克子孙，病人无药主沉昏(子能医药)；子孙发动伤官鬼，占病求医身便痊(鬼制病安)；妻财发动，病者伤脾并胃虚(财为饮食)；兄弟克财，病人占者恐悲哀；官鬼克兄弟，病困门庭祸崇来(病占忌鬼)

rule.yi: 海底眼的六亲爻动一节，每一句后面带眉批：父母爻动克子孙，病人没有药、主昏沉（眉批：子能医药）；子孙发动伤官鬼，占病求医身体就痊愈（眉批：鬼被制住、病就安）；妻财发动，病人伤脾、胃虚（眉批：财是饮食）；兄弟克财，占病的人恐怕悲哀（眉批：兄动反复）；官鬼克兄弟，病困、门庭里有祸崇（眉批：占病忌鬼）。
rule.en: The section on the six relations moving in the Haidi Yan has a marginal comment after each line: when the Resource line moves and controls Output, the sick have no medicine and are heavily drowsy (comment: Output can doctor and medicate); when Output moves and harms Pressure, in divining illness and seeking a doctor the body is cured at once (comment: the ghost is held down and the illness settles); when Wealth moves, the sick have a harmed spleen and a deficient stomach (comment: Wealth is food and drink); when Peer controls Wealth, the one divining the illness fears grief (comment: when Peer moves there is relapse); when Pressure controls Peer, the illness is stuck and a curse comes to the household (comment: in divining illness, avoid the ghost).

en: the Resource line comes head-on and controls Output (the children)
the father line can control the son line
the sick have no medicine, which means heavy drowsiness
the son line can doctor and medicate
Output moves and harms Pressure
the son line can control the ghost line
in divining illness and seeking a doctor, the body is cured at once
the ghost is held down and the illness settles
the sick have a harmed spleen and a deficient stomach
Wealth is food and drink
Peer and its kind control Wealth
'kind' means the same kind
the one divining the illness fears grief
when the Peer line moves, there is relapse
Pressure has always controlled Peer
when the ghost moves it controls the Peer line

yi: 病困，门庭里有祸、有崇来到
en: the illness is stuck, and misfortune and a curse come to the household
in divining illness, the ghost is avoided

dispute.yi: 同一首歌诀在卜筮全书的六亲发动诀里也有（LY.ILL.BSQS.06），父动、子动两句几乎一样（「沉昏」「昏沉」只是字序），另外三处说的不一样：妻财发动，海底眼写「病者伤脾并胃虚」（脾和胃），卜筮全书写「病人伤胃更伤脾」，意思相近；兄弟克财，海底眼写「病人占者恐悲哀」（占病的人恐怕悲哀），卜筮全书写「病人难愈未离灾」（病难好、没有离开灾）；官鬼克兄弟，海底眼写「官鬼从来克兄弟」「病困门庭祸崇来」（病困），卜筮全书写「官鬼发动克兄弟」「病因门庭祸祟来」（病因）。「病困」和「病因」是一字之差、意思不同：一个说病重困顿，一个说病的原因是门庭里的祸祟。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The same song is also in the verses on the six relations moving in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.06), and the lines for the Resource and Output moving are almost the same (the 'heavy drowsiness' differs only in the order of the characters); the other three differ: for Wealth moving the Haidi Yan writes 'the sick have a harmed spleen and a deficient stomach' (spleen and stomach) while the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the sick harm the stomach and then the spleen', close in sense; for Peer controlling Wealth the Haidi Yan writes 'the one divining the illness fears grief' while the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the illness is hard to cure and has not left calamity' (the illness is hard to mend, not yet free of calamity); for Pressure controlling Peer the Haidi Yan writes 'Pressure has always controlled Peer' and 'the illness is stuck, and misfortune and a curse come to the household' (stuck) while the Bushi Quanshu writes 'Pressure moves and controls Peer' and 'the cause of the illness is that misfortune and a curse come to the household' (cause). 'Stuck' and 'cause' differ by one character and in sense: one says the illness is heavy and stuck, the other that the cause of the illness is a misfortune and curse in the household. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 每一句后面括号里的眉批，是这部书自己的旁注（「海底眼眉批」），原文里夹在两个分句中间，所以每句经文和它的眉批分开引，各引一段。眉批大多是四个字的提示：「子能医药」是子孙爻管医药，「鬼制病安」是鬼被克制、病就安，「病占忌鬼」是占病忌讳鬼爻动。「兄动反复」的「反复」是病情反复。「同谓同类」的「同」是兄弟同人的同，指同类。「崇」是「祟」的写法。这一节在原书里每一个六亲各有一首，这里只取讲到病的句子；六亲爻变、六亲持世见 LY.ILL.HDY.16、HDY.17。
note.en: The marginal comments in brackets after each line are the book's own side notes ('Haidi Yan marginal comments'); in the original they sit between two phrases, so each line of the verse and its comment are quoted separately, one quotation each. Most comments are four-character prompts: 'the son line can doctor and medicate' says the Output line governs doctors and medicine, 'the ghost is held down and the illness settles' says the ghost is controlled and so the illness settles, and 'in divining illness, the ghost is avoided' says in divining illness it is feared if the ghost line moves. The 'relapse' of 'when the Peer line moves, there is relapse' is the illness going back and forth. The 'kind' of 'Peer and its kind' is the 'same' of the same kind. The character for 'curse' is written in a variant form. In the original book each of the six relations has a verse of its own, and only the lines that speak of illness are taken here; for the six relations changing and holding the Self see LY.ILL.HDY.16 and HDY.17.

units.title: 六亲爻变·疾病：官化官兮病未安(谓之化去)；官化文书官未顺，纵能忧病还为吉(病凶亦吉)；兄化官占病难医哭泣临(鬼能克子)；子化官兮防祸患，占疾忧疑总不中(医药受克)

rule.yi: 海底眼的六亲爻变一节（「甲化乙」是甲爻发动、变出乙爻），带眉批的讲病的句子有四处：官鬼化官鬼，病没有好（眉批：叫化去）；官鬼化父母，官还不顺，就是忧着病也还是吉（眉批：病凶也吉）；兄弟化官鬼，占病难医、哭泣临门（眉批：鬼能克子）；子孙化官鬼，要防祸患，占病忧疑总是不中（眉批：医药受克）。
rule.en: In the section on the six relations changing in the Haidi Yan ('A changes into B' means line A moves and changes out line B), with its marginal comments there are four places that speak of illness: Pressure changing into Pressure, the illness has not mended (comment: this is called 'turning away'); Pressure changing into Resource, the official matter is not yet smooth, but even worrying about illness it is still auspicious (comment: illness ominous is also auspicious); Peer changing into Pressure, in divining illness it is hard to treat and weeping comes (comment: the ghost can control Output); Output changing into Pressure, guard against misfortune, and in divining illness doubt and worry never hit the mark (comment: medicine is controlled).

yi: 官鬼化出官鬼，病没有好
en: Pressure changing into Pressure, the illness has not mended
it is called 'turning away'

yi: 官鬼化出父母，官事还不顺
en: Pressure changing into Resource, the official matter is not yet smooth

yi: 官爻超过文书，文书难成
en: the official line overtakes the document, and the document is hard to make
even if one worries about illness, it is still auspicious
illness ominous is also auspicious

yi: 兄弟化出官鬼，不要告状
en: Peer changing into Pressure, do not file a suit
in divining illness it is hard to treat, and weeping arrives
the ghost line can control the son line

yi: 子孙化出官鬼，要防祸患
en: Output changing into Pressure, guard against misfortune
Output most fears changing into Pressure

yi: 占病，忧虑疑惑总是不中
en: in divining illness, doubt and worry never hit the mark
medicine is controlled

note.yi: 「化去」是眉批在好几处用的词（「财化财兮……（谓之化去）」「子化子兮……（谓之化去）」），指化出同类、变而不变。「官化文书」的「文书」是父母爻（文书属父母）；「纵能忧病还为吉」接在「官化文书官未顺」后面，字面是「纵然担忧着病，也还吉」，眉批「病凶亦吉」只有四个字，没有展开，译文照字面。「兄化官兮休下状」后面的眉批「事元十象」意思不清，这里不引。「占疾忧疑总不中」的「不中」是不应验、不符合，「医药受克」是眉批给的原因：子孙化官鬼，子孙（医药）被官鬼克。卜筮全书的六亲变化歌（LY.ILL.BSQS.07）讲「化鬼忧病产」「化财占病凶」，和这里的几条不是同一批句子。这一节在原书里有校者的话「此篇各节明显错乱」，指节与节的次序，这里没有受影响。
note.en: 'Turning away' is a word the marginal comments use in several places ('Wealth changing into Wealth ... (it is called turning away)', 'Output changing into Output ... (it is called turning away)'), meaning changing into its own kind, a change that is no change. The 'document' of 'Pressure changing into Resource' is the Resource line (documents belong to Resource); 'even if one worries about illness, it is still auspicious' follows 'the official matter is not yet smooth', its literal sense is 'even though worrying about illness, it is also auspicious', and the comment 'illness ominous is also auspicious' is only four characters and is not expanded, and is translated literally. The comment 'the matter at root ten images' after 'Peer changing into Pressure, do not file a suit' is unclear and is not quoted. The 'does not hit' of 'doubt and worry never hit the mark' is not borne out or not fitting, and 'medicine is controlled' is the reason given by the comment: Output changes into Pressure, and Output (medicine) is controlled by Pressure. The verses on the six relations changing in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.07) say 'changing into the ghost, worry for illness and childbirth' and 'changing into Wealth, divining illness is ominous', which are not the same lines as these. The book has an editor's remark at the head of this section that 'the sections of this part are plainly out of order', which concerns the order of the sections and does not affect this.

units.chapter_en: The Six Relations Holding the Self
units.title: 六亲持世·鬼世：官鬼持世事难安(鬼世祸殃)；占身不病也遭官(病讼因官)

rule.yi: 海底眼的六亲持世一节，鬼世一首：官鬼持世事难安（眉批：鬼持世是祸殃）；占身不病也要遭官司（眉批：病、官司都因官鬼）。
rule.en: In the section on the six relations holding the Self in the Haidi Yan, the verse for the ghost holding the Self: with Pressure holding the Self, affairs are hard to settle (comment: the ghost holding the Self is misfortune); in divining oneself, even if not ill one meets official trouble (comment: illness and lawsuits both come from Pressure).

yi: 官鬼持世，事情难得安稳
en: with Pressure holding the Self, affairs are hard to settle
the ghost holding the Self is misfortune

yi: 占自己，就是不生病也要遭官司
en: in divining oneself, even if not ill one meets official trouble
illness and lawsuits both come from Pressure

note.yi: 这一首的经文和卜筮全书诸爻持世诀里的「鬼爻持世事难安，占身不病也遭官」（LY.ILL.BSQS.04）是同一联，文王金钱课的诸爻持事诀（第 9 行）也有；这里的字句是「官鬼持世」（卜筮全书写「鬼爻持世」），眉批「病讼因官」是说：病和官司都是官鬼带来的。「占身」是占自己；「不病也遭官」的「官」是官司。这一首后面两句「财物时时忧失脱，骨肉分离会合难」讲的是财物和亲人，不收。
note.en: The verse text of this one is the same couplet as 'with the ghost line holding the Self, affairs are hard to settle; in divining oneself, even if not ill one meets official trouble' (LY.ILL.BSQS.04) in the verses of the lines holding the Self of the Bushi Quanshu, and it is also in the verses on lines holding the affair of the Wenwang Jinqian Ke (line 9); the wording here is 'Pressure holding the Self' (the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the ghost line holding the Self'), and the comment 'illness and lawsuits both come from Pressure' says that illness and lawsuits are both brought by Pressure. 'Divining oneself' is divining for oneself; the 'official' of 'meets official trouble' is a lawsuit. The two lines after it, 'one is always worried about losing goods; kin separate and meeting again is hard', are about goods and relatives and are not taken.
